column3: NASB moves “when Jerusalem was captured” (from 38:28) to the start of this verse.
“It was broken into” is rendered “the city wall was breached”; NASB supplies “wall.”
The names are divided differently in NASB (“Samgar-nebu, Sar-sekim”); the Hebrew division of the names is uncertain.
“Those who had fallen to him” is rendered “the deserters.”
The Hebrew writes a word (“that”) that is not read; NASB follows the reading. “Set your eyes on him” is rendered “look after him.”
“Your life to plunder” is rendered “your own life as booty.”
